seoDescription: The Churchman Lab is a multidisciplinary group of biologists, chemists, physicists and computational scientists at Harvard Medical School, led by Professor L. Stirling Churchman. Current members and lab alumni.
title: Our team
intro: A multidisciplinary group of scientists who love gene expression, mitochondria and RNA — with training in biology, chemistry, physics, neuroscience, public health and computation.
